entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: S-So we're really gonna do this, huh...?[n]You think it'll be okay?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: If it turns out to be sketchy, we can[n]just bail.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The apartment's vacant, so it's not like[n]we'll be messing with anyone's home.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We'll be fiiine. You're a real wuss,[n]you know that?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: To think... Sakamoto has a brain.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: But if that's the case, then...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I-I'm not good with that kinda stuff![n]Seriously! Please, [lName]!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, I guess he could do it too.[n]Okay, go for it, Mishima.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: I-I'm not good with that kinda stuff![n]Seriously! Please, [lName]!

entries.speaker: Man's Voice
entries.en: Thank you for calling! This is[n]Victoria's Housekeeping!

entries.speaker: Victoria Employee
entries.en: I take it you're interested in[n]our services, then?

entries.speaker: Victoria Employee
entries.en: Is there anyone in particular you'd[n]like to request?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: A-Anyone we want to request!? [n]What should we do, [fName]!?

entries.speaker: Victoria Employee
entries.en: We have a maid available in...[n]twenty minutes.

entries.speaker: Victoria Employee
entries.en: May I ask for your address?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Hey... What should we have her do?[n]I was thinking we start with some[n]cooking...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Of course, I wouldn't mind some[n]of the other services either...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: ...Should we hold a strategy meeting[n]to discuss?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh, I gotta use the bathroom...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: You were in there for a while... Are you[n]okay? Hey, did you wash your hands?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Are high school students even[n]allowed to use this type of service?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: What do you mean, "Huh"? [n]You should've researched it!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: What if they find out who we are!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: H-How should I know!? But why would[n]how old you are matter when it comes[n]to housekeeping?

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: We would've been screwed if[n]your number had shown up on[n]their caller ID...

entries.speaker: Woman's Voice
entries.en: Good evening... I'm from the[n]housekeeping service.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: What do we do!? I'm not mentally[n]prepared!

entries.speaker: Woman's Voice
entries.en: Oh, the door's unlocked...? [n]Um, may I come in...?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: My stomach's actin' up! And my[n]hands are all sweaty!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Okay, you handle the rest... And don't[n]let her find out you're a high school[n]student.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I've got your back! Just... From way back![n]Like, from the balcony!

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Wh-What? I can't do this either! [n][lName], we'll leave it to you!
Ryuji and Mishima fled to the balcony...

entries.speaker: Woman in Maid Outfit
entries.en: Excuse me... Oh, there you are!

entries.speaker: Woman in Maid Outfit
entries.en: I'm going to fill your tired heart full of[n]lovely energy. Meow! [clr 2][f 1 9 0][clr 27]

entries.speaker: Woman in Maid Outfit
entries.en: I'm Becky, and I have the pleasure[n]of serving you today. [clr 2][f 1 9 0][clr 27]

entries.speaker: Becky
entries.en: We're going to get along [n]so well! Meeeooowww! [clr 2][f 1 9 0][clr 27][clr 2][f 1 9 0][clr 27]

entries.speaker: Becky
entries.en: Oh my... how thoughtless of me![n]I should explain our services[n]to you, Master!

entries.speaker: Becky
entries.en: What would you like me to do today?[n]The basics include cooking, cleaning,[n]laundry...

entries.speaker: Becky
entries.en: But there are other "services" we[n]provide if you desire. [clr 2][f 1 9 0][clr 27]

entries.speaker: Becky
entries.en: Wait, that was a joke, right...?

entries.speaker: Becky
entries.en: You're not lying to me, are you...?

entries.speaker: Becky
entries.en: Hmmm, I'll wait to provide those[n]other "services" until you've[n]matured a bit, Master. [clr 2][f 1 9 0][clr 27]

entries.speaker: Becky
entries.en: Oh, no, it's all right. How would[n]you know me?

entries.speaker: Becky
entries.en: This is our first meeting. Yes, the first[n]time ever, Master. [clr 2][f 1 9 0][clr 27]

entries.speaker: Becky
entries.en: Yes, it's me... your homeroom teacher...

entries.speaker: Becky
entries.en: Kawakami[n]...I'm so done... I can't believe I got[n]caught by some of my own students...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I should've taken a job outside of the city.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But I needed it to be close to school so[n]I could go there after I finished work...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Who did you hear about this from?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Oh! It was Ms. Chouno, wasn't it!?[n]That harpy...!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: She's been snooping on all the[n]teachers ever since that incident[n]with Mr. Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Are you going to tell Ms. Chouno[n]about this?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Hmmm... It doesn't seem like[n]you're playing dumb...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: In any case, I'll get in big trouble[n]if you tell on me.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Hey, if you're going to side with a[n]teacher, side with me. I'm in charge[n]of your class, after all.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: And if you promise not to tell[n]Ms. Chouno about this, I'll do[n]anything for you!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Hey... It won't be any better for you if[n]people find out that you called a maid[n]service.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: This isn't even your home address[n]to begin with, is it? I guess you at[n]least thought about that.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Well, I'll promise to keep this[n]a secret too... so why don't we[n]both forget this ever happened?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'll treat this as if you had canceled,[n]so you won't have to pay anything.[n]Okay?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: On that note, I'll be leaving!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Don't say anything about this[n]at school, okay!? Just act as if[n]nothing ever happened!
